_description: Variant flag: per-destination credits proportional to RTT (84 + 71.4 ns/hop), idle credits borrowable. Apply after t18_full.json (and a t18_w*.json). T18 (ISCA'27 new m2, two-sided merge of remote requests). Extends mi200.json; e.g. -config t18_dist.json. Adds only -t18-* flags to mi200.json; later files in a -config list override earlier ones.
